evaluatorLimitation: Single-model-family limitation: independent blind review was executed in a fresh, isolated Vertex AI session using anonymized MP4 files with zero version labels or Director context, but uses the same Gemini model family configured in the workspace rather than a human panel or cross-vendor model.
comparativeSummary: Sample Beta is the strongest edit, featuring consistent narrative pacing, an informative custom banner, balanced audio transitions, and a clean ending free of technical glitches. Sample Gamma has good narration but lacks an on-screen hook banner and flashes an unintended split-screen montage at the end. Sample Alpha is the weakest due to robotic narration and the same outro flash glitch.
remainingWeaknessesInPreferredSample: The narration could provide slightly deeper analytical commentary regarding the specific legal definition of 911 misuse, and dynamic animated captions could be utilized more effectively during narrator segments.

unblindedSamples.voiceNaturalnessAndMixing: Voice generation sounds somewhat synthesized; audio ducking is acceptable but flat.
unblindedSamples.styleComparisonToReference: Lacks the rhythmic interspersion, punchy commentary, and active perspective seen in the reference.
